reviews.t: Cool once you get the hang of it....but the price...
reviews.x: I'm someone with extremely thick and stick straight hair.  My hair loses curl within an hour of me fixing it.  I've tried other rotating curling irons and haven't had much success with them, so I didn't have very high expectations for this beach waver.  I have been pleasantly surprised.  Once I got the hang of it, I found it to be pretty easy to use. reviews.t: Buy it!!! Perfect curls - hassle free
reviews.x: I’ve been trying to perfect curling my hair for years and this is just what I needed!!! It makes curling your hair SO easy. Literally just push a button! It take 1-2 times to get used to it, but it is seriously a life saver! Worth every penny

reviews.t: Love how simple and easy to use the Beachwaver is!!!
reviews.x: This curling iron is amazing. I’m loving it and the ease of use just makes it all the better.  I just cut 13 inches off of my hair and it now barely reaches my shoulders.  I was really struggling to use my normal 1 in curling iron because of this so I decided to try this one because of the rotating barrel hoping it would help me.  It makes beautiful curls and they last forever.  I will definitely be retiring my old normal hot tools curling iron permanently to use this one most of the time.  I al

reviews.t: Love this product. Easiest curler ever.
reviews.x: I suck at using curlers, never knew how to even do it properly. But I ordered this in hopes that it would change my luck with them. And girl, let me tell you. This is the easiest thing to use. I have decently long and thicker hair, slightly wavy and lots of volume and this was amazing to me. Extremely easy. And it works so dang well. If I curl and use some Frizz Ease spray and then lightly brush it out between each curl, it lasts all day long. Im in love with this curler. Absolutely worth the mo

reviews.t: Top tool for the lazy hairstylist
reviews.x: For the busy/stressed mom of an elementary-age child during COVID-my own hair has taken the backseat....of a large bus! I wanted to try something new to inspire me to give myself attention here again. Not only did I love the results this product gave, but I actually enjoyed learning how to use it! No lie, I’m lazy with hair. This let me be lazy enough with amazing results that look like I labored intensely! I’m satisfied with this purchase for sure.

I've used this to curl my hair a few times already and while the automatic feature is cool and convenient to give some relief to your poor arm, I can't justify the cost. You can create beach waves with any entry level low cost curling iron.  I wasn't able to great "beach waves", nope, just regular curls. But since it has dual rotation, you can make both sides of your hair match!  It is easy to figure out so I didn't have any trouble with that. It seems like high quality and was presented in the

reviews.t: More difficult to use than I expected
reviews.x: I really wanted to love this product, but my hair is relatively short and I think this product works better with longer hair.
Easy to use but can’t get the curl to stay even with their beachwave protection and hold spray.

reviews.t: Needs improvement in design and price
reviews.x: Clip is to short and hard to use not worth the price.

reviews.t: Did not work after taking it out of the box!!
reviews.x: I was SO excited to receive this!  I took it out of the box and plugged it in. It heated up quickly and them started beeping with 3 lines and turned off. I unplugged, tried again & still nothing. The barrel does not turn when pushing the arrows either. I am debating on ordering another one (after returning this one) since I am hoping this was a fluke.... Very expensive for an item that doesn't work!!

I’ve never been able to curl my hair with a curling iron, wands are difficult too. I’ve used my straightener to curl but it took an hour. This took literally 20 minutes tops with no hassle. Now I can go out looking like my hair is actually done cute instead of my straight. I love it!

I love this! I used to be so bad at curling my hair but this curler makes it so easy! All you have to do is clip the hair at the bottom & press the button in the direction you want the curl! my curls have never been better! Worth the price

reviews.t: really nice and easy to use
reviews.x: Might take a couple of tries to get used to if you've never used a curler before, but it's so easy to use and I really don't have any complaints.
Gorgeous curls with this! Pretty easy to use overall.
Like: Easy to use. Dislike: Clamp could be longer.

I tried this iron at my friend’s house to compare it to my other curling iron.  The clip is very short and cannot hold much hair.  Also, do not hit the home button while you have your hair in it or you will have a very nasty surprise: your hair might be sucked up even more. reviews.t: I was skeptical but this is super amazing
reviews.x: First off, I know it pricey for a curling iron but it actually does the trick and is pretty cool. You clip your hair in the bottom little clipper and I prefer the low speed and it winds your hair for you up the wand! It gets nice and hot and curls did stay well after hrs or wear in semi humid weather. Definitely takes a little getting use to but it’s pretty cool. You do need to take slightly smaller sections of hair to curl so the clipper can hold it but I really enjoyed using this!

reviews.t: Giving 5 stars even though it didn't work for me
reviews.x: There's nothing wrong with this curler. In fact, it's got some great attributes: ergonomic, swivel cord, push button start/temp changes, nice stand and area to put your fingers so they don't burn. Unfortunately my hair is too short for a 1" barrel: a bit shorter than my shoulders. So I didn't have enough real estate to wrap but I think otherwise it would have worked perfectly. Bummed because I really wanted it to work.

Even after taking time to get over the learning curve, I still got this weird little kinky thing at the ends of my hair. Also, the barrel is way too short for anything slightly over shoulder length. I know they have a longer barrel and a different model, but it’s twice the price and I’m just gonna go with a traditional curling iron. That is top quality. I wouldn’t really waste your money.

Wow super super disappointed in this device.  I have kept curling irons for over 20+ years and I have had this device since early Feb 2023.  It is not heating to the temperature I need it too. I use it maybe once or twice a month so it is not even worn out because of consistent overuse.  THUMBS DOWN
I’ve never been able to get those beach wave curls with regular curling irons so this gadget was worth a try and it’s so easy to use!  Only thing I would change is a wider barrel.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the curler as easy to use, even for people who struggle with regular curling irons or wands.
Several reviewers feel the product is overpriced relative to its performance.
Some reviewers report the curls don't hold or the heat isn't sufficient, especially for thick or straight hair.
A few reviewers mention design or usability drawbacks, such as a short clip, large size, or difficulty with shorter hair.
At least one reviewer received a defective unit that did not work out of the box.
